cases.evidence_scope: Native HF02 ObjectStroke apply/Drawing selects GLV16 and records 76 native RTV5 AddPoint outputs. A synchronous host queue adapter dispatches the captured native task vtables in submission order: native SendDataToGPU receives the live vector, then native PenGLRenderMsg paints to the native SPPenCanvas bitmap, followed by native vector deletion. Native resource construction and GLES callbacks are host adapters; the 1920x1080 RGBA readback is host Mesa output, not Android scheduling, device pixels, or public Notes playback.
cases.renderer_init_error: Init/Draw are not separate host calls; the captured native PenGLRenderMsg task performs the paint path
